signals.name: regexSteps
signals.quantity: total calls to Pattern$Node.match(Matcher, int, CharSequence) across all Pattern$* subclasses during one fuzz execution — i.e., total regex NFA backtracking steps
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in org.keycloak.fuzzing.agent.RegexStepCounter.STEPS — single-element array for unboxed increment
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() calls RegexStepCounter.getAndReset() before providing the next input
signals.read: V1Guidance.handleResult() calls RegexStepCounter.get() to read the total NFA steps; value returned by lastSignals() as {"regexSteps": <count>}

plans.retention: Primary: retain if regexSteps exceeds the best step count seen in the corpus (or is in the top percentile). Secondary (while signal is flat): retain if input length exceeds the longest corpus entry, ensuring growth toward input_bytes and beyond. Diversity: periodically retain a random input regardless of step count. Prioritization for parent selection: weighted by regexSteps (or by input length when all steps are zero).
mutation: byte-level: random byte flip at a random position
byte-level: random byte insertion at a random position
byte-level: random byte deletion at a random position
byte-level: random block overwrite with random or dictionary bytes

repetition: select a random byte range [start, end) and repeat it k times (k up to maxInputSize/chunkLen), including special case of doubling the entire input, to grow toward 10240 bytes — reaches input_bytes (2560) from a 16-byte seed in ~8 doublings (<1 minute)

dictionary: insert or overwrite with tokens from the source on the attack path — 0x09 (tab, matches \s and [^: ]), 0x0D (CR), 0x0C (FF), 0x0B (VT), 0x22 (double-quote), 0x3A (colon), 0x5C (backslash), 0x20 (space) — each a single syntactic unit from SearchQueryUtils.queryPattern
